set.body:
Current release group: release-1.0; milestone-evidence; child of G1, accepted S2b direction in ADR 0019.
Outcome: a concrete checked OnnxSentenceEmbedder mints an immutable RecordedBatch after its actual adapter attempt. Exact in-memory replay returns the original outcomes and receipt without invoking the provider.
Scope: embed-onnx only plus ADR/evidence; no dependency or strict-channel registration change. This proves an adapter attempt, not successful native inference: all-TooLong and keyless-sensitive requests remain typed failures/denials. Synthetic offline fixture only; no private data/model acquisition or scientific efficacy claim.
Acceptance: mint only from concrete record(batch), never a public BatchResult/receipt factory. Capture the exact ordered request sequence and actual model/artifacts/provider/runtime/geometries. Replay refuses independently changed payload/sensitivity, IDs/order, geometry, expected provider or model configuration; exact replay works after the encoder is closed and preserves original receipts/failures. Text-free refusals/toString; no new plain digest of non-public material. Outside-package apply/constructor/copy/fromProduct/Mirror courts have same-shape positive controls. Compiled guard/forgeability mutations fail the named courts. Fatal-warning reference-scope gate, exact-SHA independent review, hosted evidence/publication and approved-host sync.
Remaining on parent G1: checked bound surface rendering, explicit metric scale (raw cosine [0,2] vs strict [0,1]), registered strict channel/candidate/config identities, immutable nomination/pricing and StageTrace adoption. This child does not close AC2 or certify strict reference eligibility. No coarse dependency refinement or lexical substitution is introduced.
Completion: qualified source d7c0d97a37a6a1ae375f7f12f250e8f7317f591f landed with independent exact-SHA GO and GitHub/approved buc-gw01 parity. Evidence: docs/refactor/evidence/g1-onnx-attempt-20261007. Next action: resume parent G1 checked bound rendering, declared metric scale/registration and shared evidence/StageTrace acceptance.
